job.title: Sales & Promotions Operations Specialist
job.description:
Most marketing roles finish when the campaign goes live. In this one, that's when it gets interesting.
A leading automotive aftermarket group is looking for a Sales & Promotions "guru" to be the central coordination point for its 45 branches. You'll keep promotions, launches and business activity on track across Marketing, Sales, Product and Operations, and become the person branch and regional managers call first.
Behind the scenes, you'll keep everything organised: the planners, trackers, briefs and reports that keep a busy promotional calendar running smoothly. You'll also support performance reporting and business planning by analysing how promotions are performing, spotting what's working and what isn't, and making sure the information behind every decision is accurate and easy to understand.
If you love the buzz of a promotion day, enjoy picking up the phone and get a kick out of making things happen, this is your role.

What's in it for you?

  • Be the go-to person. You'll be the connection between the marketing team and the branch network, with the relationships and visibility that come with it.
  • See your work land. Catalogues, weekly promotions and one-day sales run all year, and you'll follow the results in real time and help branches lift their performance.
  • Own the plan. You'll build and run the activity planner as a single source of truth, and shape the processes and reporting that keep the business aligned.
  • Make your insights count. You'll see what's working and what isn't, and your recommendations will feed straight into the next campaign.
  • Work across the business. You'll work with Marketing, Sales, Product and Operations, with exposure to the whole commercial picture.
  • Learn it first-hand. You'll spend time in branches as part of your induction, so you understand how the business really runs.
  • Build your career. There are development opportunities across the group's network of brands.
  • Enjoy the extras. Staff discounts across the group's brands, paid birthday, maternity and paternity leave, discounted health insurance, free onsite parking and HEAPS more.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning and maintaining the activity planner and marketing calendar, looking ahead a quarter to half year, with clear owners, milestones and deadlines
  • Coordinating promotions, product launches and business initiatives across multiple teams
  • Preparing and distributing promotional briefs, launch packs and branch communications so every branch knows what's happening and when
  • Communicating promotions, targets and results to branch and regional managers, including loyalty program activity
  • Running live updates and leaderboards on promotion days, and calling branches to find out what's working
  • Tracking actions, approvals and key deliverables, keeping records up to date and following up until things are done
  • Analysing promotion and sales results to understand what's working, and recommending changes to messaging, timing or targeting
  • Preparing regular performance updates from accurate, consistent data, turning the commercial team's reporting into clear, practical insights for branches and leaders
  • Spotting gaps, clashes and risks early, and escalating them before they become problems
  • Continuously improving how information is shared, so campaigns don't reach the branches at the last minute

About you

You're highly organised, personable and comfortable with numbers. You might come from sales support, marketing coordination, project or operations support, or a fast-paced operational business. You'll bring:

  • Ideally, some exposure to retail, trade, wholesale or a multi-site network (automotive experience is not essential, but very nice to have)
  • Experience coordinating activity, promotions or projects across multiple stakeholders
  • Confidence as a friendly communicator, comfortable having straight conversations, chasing results and keeping branch managers on side
  • A methodical approach to planning, documentation and record keeping, with a keen eye for detail
  • Confidence with Excel and reporting tools (Power BI exposure is helpful)
  • A curious, analytical mind, with the ability to read commercial reports, spot trends and turn them into simple actions
  • Sales energy, initiative and a drive to chase results

Interested?
If you're ready to be the heartbeat of a busy promotional calendar, we'd love to hear from you. Please APPLY asap or for question contact Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity at gabbys@peopleequity.com.au or via 0432 261 116. Shortlisting immediately.

job.title: Category & Supplier Performance Analyst
job.description:
About the business

This exciting retail and wholesale group is on the move. It owns a portfolio of brands that both B2B and B2C customers know and trust. It offers the stability and resources of a large organisation, along with a collaborative, roll-up-your-sleeves culture where good ideas get heard. The group is investing in growth, modernising how it works, and building stronger, more strategic relationships with its key suppliers.

As part of this, it is lifting the way it measures and manages supplier performance, bringing information together across its businesses to create one clear, consistent view. At the heart of that change is a new trade partner program with strong executive backing. Now the business needs someone with the energy and follow-through to turn data into insight, and every commitment into a result.

What's in it for you

  • Analysis with a purpose: your insights will feed directly into decisions made by senior leaders and category teams.
  • A group-wide view: you'll work across multiple businesses and see the bigger commercial picture, which few analyst roles offer.
  • Build your commercial edge: you'll develop a deep understanding of supplier performance, margin and category drivers.
  • Shape the standard: as a new role, you'll help define how performance is reported and presented across the group.
  • Grow with support: you'll have a leader who will coach you and back you, with a clear pathway into category or procurement for strong performers.

What you'll be doing

Reporting to the GM Group Category Strategy, you'll be the engine behind the group's strategic trade partner program, making sure what is agreed with suppliers actually gets delivered. You will:

  • coordinate the planning and review rhythm with strategic trade partners, including pre-work, preparation sessions, scorecards and review packs
  • partner with Group Category Leads across the businesses, helping them get the most out of the framework
  • pull data from the group's reporting systems, sense check it with stakeholders, and turn it into clear, consistent and professional insight
  • track agreed actions and results against plan, follow up internal teams and trade partners, and escalate early when progress stalls
  • contribute to regular reporting to senior leadership on progress, roadblocks and wins
  • identify improvements to templates, reporting and ways of working as the program grows.

About you

You're a switched-on, early-career professional who is just as comfortable chasing an action as building a spreadsheet. You love bringing order to complexity, you're not afraid to follow up, and you enjoy seeing your work turn into real outcomes.

You also have:

  • strong experience in a consulting, a commercial, retail/wholesale analyst role, supply or demand planning, or another analytical role with strong stakeholder exposure.
  • an understanding of commercial and supplier performance drivers, such as margin, mix, price, volume and inventory, ideally gained in retail or wholesale
  • the determination to hold others to their commitments, and the judgement to know when to escalate
  • the confidence to engage senior stakeholders, with clear written and verbal communication
  • a proactive, organised and fast-paced approach, and a genuine "get it done" attitude
  • a relevant tertiary qualification
  • strong Excel skills and confidence working with Power BI reports

Interested?
Click Apply ASAP! If you have any questions reach out to Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity at gabbys@peopleequity.com.au or on 0432 261 116.

job.title: Senior Store Manager
job.description:
Imagine loving where you work again...

  • Imagine walking into a store where your team genuinely enjoys coming to work…
  • Where you're trusted to lead…
  • Where you're encouraged to have fun…
  • Where your wins are celebrated...
  • And where your employer invests as much in your career as you invest in your people.

That's exactly what this opportunity offers.

Here's the exciting part...

  • Take the reins of one of the group's flagship stores—one of the largest (close to 4,000 sq m), highest-turnover stores within the group, with remarkable year-on-year growth and an exciting future ahead.
  • Work for a retailer that invests in people, not just stores. You'll be trusted to make decisions, backed by experienced leaders and given every opportunity to build a long-term career.
  • Forget being thrown in the deep end. You'll experience one of the best onboarding programs in retail, spending time across multiple stores and with key leaders in the store, before officially taking the keys to your own.
  • Be in a role, which will also give you some work life balance. You'll only work one Saturday a fortnight, with every alternate weekend off.
  • Love coming to work again. The culture is welcoming, down-to-earth, customer obsessed and built around trust, teamwork and celebrating success.
  • Be rewarded for what you bring. An attractive base salary, super, bonus and fully maintained vehicle reflect the importance of this leadership role.

The opportunity:

This isn't simply about running a successful store...it's about leading one of the business's largest and most commercially significant operations. You’ll:

  • Have full accountability for sales, profitability, customer experience, operational excellence and, most importantly, your people.
  • You’ll build an environment where your team feels supported, challenged and inspired to become the very best version of themselves.
  • You'll recruit exceptional talent, develop future leaders, drive commercial performance, identify new opportunities for growth and ensure every customer leaves wanting to come back.

This is a role for someone who loves retail, thrives in a fast-paced environment and gets genuine satisfaction from seeing both people and performance flourish.

About you:

You're already an accomplished Store Manager (or above) from a big box or large-format retail environment, and you've built your reputation by growing both the business and the people around you.

You'll bring:

  • Experience running a serious retail operation—a large team, significant turnover, demanding customers and plenty of moving parts.
  • A genuine feel for the numbers. You know what's driving performance, where the opportunities are hiding and when something needs attention before it becomes a problem.
  • The ability to turn strong results into even stronger ones. This store is already performing exceptionally well, so your challenge is to keep building momentum rather than simply maintaining it.
  • A knack for getting the best out of people. You know how to set high expectations, build capability and create a team that genuinely enjoys coming to work.
  • Strong retail instincts. Stock availability, merchandising, inventory, wage control, shrinkage and customer service are simply how you operate.
  • The confidence to make decisions and back yourself. You stay calm under pressure, lead change positively and know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.
  • A leadership style people naturally follow. You're visible, approachable, decisive and never afraid to roll up your sleeves alongside your team.
  • Plenty of energy and ambition. You love retail, enjoy winning, celebrate success and are always looking for ways to improve both your people and your business.

If you're looking for more than just another Store Manager role—if you're looking for somewhere you can genuinely belong, make your mark and build a long-term career—we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply ASAP via the APPLY button. For further questions, contact Gabby Symons on 0432 261 116 or gabbys@peopleequity.com.au.

job.title: GM - Business Development
job.description:
What's in it for you?

This is a refreshing opportunity...as you're not joining a start-up searching for scale...you're starting with it.

Part of a major Australasian group, this substantial organisation operates at the intersection of healthcare, retail, pharmacy, technology and consumer services. Think major national footprint, established brands and channels, significant customer reach, rich healthcare relationships, digital and data capability - and the investment capacity to turn great opportunities into something meaningful.

The core business is established, successful and is continuously growing. Now comes the exciting part: leveraging that platform to create what's next.
New services. New markets. New partnerships. New business models. New revenue streams.

Reporting directly to the CEO and joining the Executive Leadership Team, you'll have the mandate to look beyond the traditional core business, identify where the organisation should play next - and then make it happen.

The opportunity:

This is not a traditional strategy role. We're looking for a commercial growth leader and dealmaker - someone who can see an opportunity, determine its commercial viability, find the right partner and negotiate the deal over the line. You'll leverage the organisation's customers, channels, brands, data, digital capabilities and healthcare relationships to unlock entirely new avenues for growth.

More specifically, you'll:

  • Identify and build a pipeline of high-value growth opportunities and healthcare adjacencies.
  • Explore new markets, services, business models and revenue streams.
  • Originate, structure and negotiate significant strategic partnerships and commercial agreements.
  • Identify potential new ventures, investments and acquisition opportunities.
  • Find the right partners and get the right people around the table.
  • Work alongside specialist M&A, finance and legal teams to take opportunities from concept through to execution.
  • Turn great opportunities into revenue, earnings and enterprise value.

About you:

  • You're commercially curious, entrepreneurial and naturally external. You build networks, open doors and make things happen.
  • Just as importantly, you'll thrive in a culture that values people who are humble, hungry and smart - ambitious without the ego, commercially sharp, curious and naturally collaborative.

You'll bring:

  • Senior experience across strategic partnerships, business development, corporate development, new ventures and/or commercial growth.
  • A track record of personally originating and landing significant partnerships, ventures and/or deals.
  • Evidence of creating new revenue streams, entering new markets and/or developing new business models.
  • Strong commercial and financial judgement.
  • The credibility to influence and negotiate at CEO, Executive and Board level.
  • The ability to navigate a large organisation while maintaining an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Energy, curiosity and a genuine appetite to be out in the market, creating opportunities and getting deals over the line.

Experience across healthcare, pharmaceuticals, pharmacy, diagnostics, medical services or health technology will be highly regarded. However, exceptional commercial growth leaders from consumer, retail, technology or other sophisticated service environments will also be considered.

If this sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you (Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity) so please apply ASAP.

job.title: Marketing Manager - Events & Communities
job.description:

This is not a typical marketing role, it's for a highly passionate leader who thrives on pace, energy and impact, and wants to be the driving force behind how a brand shows up in the room, not just on the page.

You'll own a busy national events calendar, spanning multiple well-known brands across the trade and consumer space, and become the single point of contact for how they come to life at every activation.


You'll be in the middle of it all: events, agencies, ambassadors, budgets and execution.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • A newly created role with real scope to shape how it grows
  • 30 to 40 major events a year across a network with huge reach
  • Genuine ownership of brand presence at events and activations
  • A new e-commerce platform build underway, with social playing a key role
  • Work with a broad portfolio of agencies, from stand builders to content specialists
  • Direct commercial impact, not just activity

This is a role centred around events and community leadership, not content admin.

About the Business


Its ASX-listed, with serious scale behind it and it has a large national footprint across both B2B and B2C channels. This is a business well recognised for setting the pace in its category, backed by a continued investment in resources. Currently doubling down on growth, there couldn't be a more opportune time to join.

What You'll Do

  • Own the major events calendar end to end: logistics, budgets, suppliers and on-the-day delivery
  • Act as the single point of contact for events, coordinating internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Manage a portfolio of external agencies, including a social-first agency handling day-to-day content
  • Own social media strategy and hold agencies and internal teams accountable for execution
  • Build and grow community engagement, working with brand ambassadors, influencers and sponsorship partners
  • Represent the brand at major industry events and conferences, bringing back fresh thinking on how the market is innovating
  • Support the rollout of a new e-commerce platform, with social playing a key role in the customer journey

What You Bring

  • A dedicated background in events, activations and project management (this is a specialist role, not a generalist marketing one)
  • A genuine, demonstrated understanding of social media as a strategic channel, with the confidence to brief and hold agencies accountable
  • Military-grade organisation: you anticipate what could go wrong and plan for it well before it happens
  • A natural people person who builds rapport fast and represents a brand well
  • Confidence working cross-functionally with agencies and multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Genuine energy for face-to-face engagement at events, including interstate travel

You move fast. You plan ahead of everyone else in the room. You make events happen; as you are always one step ahead.


If you're looking for a role where events, social and community actually matter, and you get to own how they show up, this could be one of your most career-defining moves.

APPLY now and your application will go directly to Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity.

Success is achieved in the Private Label division through the application of superior sourcing, product development, trading and planning practices and the ability to translate trends and develop products to the needs of their customers.  A career opportunity now presents for an experienced Product Manager – Private Label to conceptualise, develop and deliver exclusive new products that will capitalise on market and ranging opportunities and in turn deliver strong sales and margin growth.
